SMART PATIENT GUIDE TO NAD+ THERAPY BEFORE YOU START NAD+ Is Getting Attention— for Good Reason NAD+ has become one of the most talked-about subjects in healthy- aging and wellness circles. The interest starts with real biology. NAD+⁠—short for nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide—is a naturally occurring molecule found throughout the body. It plays an essential role in cellular energy metabolism and participates in many other fundamental cellular processes. Researchers are actively studying NAD+ metabolism, how it changes with age and health, and whether different approaches to supporting NAD+ biology may have meaningful applications for human health. But there is an important distinction: Understanding what NAD+ does naturally in the body is not the same as proving what NAD+ therapy will do for a patient. The science is well established in some areas and still developing in others. This guide will help you understand the difference. SMART PATIENT INSIGHT NAD+ has an established role in human biology. Its use as a wellness therapy is an evolving area of research. 01

SMART PATIENT GUIDE TO NAD+ THERAPY UNDERSTAND THE SCIENCE What Exactly Is NAD+? The full name is nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide. Fortunately, you don’t need to remember that. NAD+ is a naturally occurring coenzyme found throughout the body. Coenzymes help enzymes carry out important chemical reactions. One of NAD+’s fundamental roles involves the processes your cells use to convert nutrients into usable energy. NAD+ also participates in biological processes involving cellular signaling, redox reactions and normal cellular function. Think of it this way: Food & nutrients Cellular processes NAD+ participates Cellular energy & function That fundamental biology is one reason NAD+ has attracted significant scientific interest. SMART PATIENT INSIGHT NAD+ isn’t a newly invented wellness ingredient. It is a molecule your body already uses in fundamental cellular processes. 02

SMART PATIENT GUIDE TO NAD+ THERAPY NAD+ AND AGING Why Has NAD+ Become Part of the Healthy-Aging Conversation? Scientists have become increasingly interested in the relationship between NAD+ metabolism and aging. Research suggests that NAD+ availability can change with age and physiological conditions, although the pattern is complex and can differ among tissues and individuals. Because NAD+ participates in cellular energy metabolism and other important biological processes, researchers are studying whether influencing NAD+ metabolism could have useful health applications. That has led to research involving several different approaches, including: But healthy aging is complex. NAD+ should not be viewed as a cure for aging, a way to reverse aging or a treatment proven to make someone biologically younger. THE WELLPEPS APPROACH WellPeps believes wellness therapies should be considered in the context of the whole person—not as shortcuts around the fundamentals of healthy living. NAD+ itself Nicotinamide riboside (NR) Nicotinamide mononucleotide (NMN) Other approaches that may influence NAD+ metabolism SMART PATIENT INSIGHT NAD+ is one increasingly studied part of a much larger healthy-aging picture. 03

SMART PATIENT GUIDE TO NAD+ THERAPY SEPARATE BIOLOGY FROM BENEFITS What NAD+ Biology Can— and Can’t—Tell Us This is one of the most important concepts to understand about NAD+. WHAT WE KNOW NAD+ plays essential roles in normal human biology. It participates in cellular energy metabolism and numerous other cellular processes. WHAT THAT DOESN’T AUTOMATICALLY MEAN That receiving NAD+ as a therapy has been proven to: A molecule can have an essential biological role without supplementation or treatment being proven to improve every function associated with that biology. That distinction is especially important in a wellness market where biological mechanisms are sometimes presented as though they were proven patient outcomes. Increase your energy Improve mental clarity Speed recovery Reverse aging Extend lifespan Make you feel younger SMART PATIENT INSIGHT NAD+ plays an essential role in how our bodies function, and its potential applications in health and wellness are generating growing scientific interest. Ongoing research is helping us better understand how NAD+ therapy may benefit patients. 04

SMART PATIENT GUIDE TO NAD+ THERAPY UNDERSTAND THE RESEARCH NAD+ Isn’t One Research Category “NAD+ research” can mean several different things. Understanding the difference can help you evaluate claims about NAD+ therapy. NAD+ BIOLOGY Research into the role NAD+ naturally plays in cells, metabolism and other biological processes. NAD+ PRECURSORS Research involving compounds such as NR and NMN, which participate in pathways the body can use to support NAD+ metabolism. Much of the published human intervention research has involved these precursors. DIRECT NAD+ THERAPY Administration of NAD+ itself, including parenteral approaches used in some wellness settings. Research into direct NAD+ administration for wellness outcomes is less developed than the human research involving oral precursors. WHY THIS MATTERS Evidence involving one approach should not automatically be presented as evidence for another. A study involving NMN, for example, does not necessarily establish the clinical effects of injectable NAD+. SMART PATIENT QUESTION Does the research being discussed actually involve the form of NAD+ therapy I am considering? 05

SMART PATIENT GUIDE TO NAD+ THERAPY KNOW THE DIFFERENCES NAD+ vs. NR vs. NMN These terms are often discussed together, but they aren’t interchangeable. NAD+ Nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide itself. Role: A naturally occurring coenzyme involved in cellular energy metabolism and other fundamental biological processes. Wellness context: Direct NAD+ may be administered through routes such as injectable or infusion-based therapy in some wellness settings. NR Nicotinamide riboside. Role: A precursor the body can use in pathways involved in NAD+ metabolism. Research context: NR has been studied in human trials examining its ability to influence NAD+-related biomarkers and various health outcomes. NMN Nicotinamide mononucleotide. Role: Another compound involved in NAD+ biosynthetic pathways. Research context: NMN has also been studied in human research examining NAD+-related biomarkers and potential health effects. SMART PATIENT INSIGHT “NAD+ research” doesn’t necessarily mean researchers administered NAD+ itself. Always ask what compound, dose, route and population were actually studied. 06

SMART PATIENT GUIDE TO NAD+ THERAPY UNDERSTAND THE TREATMENT How Is NAD+ Therapy Used? People may encounter NAD+-related wellness approaches in several forms. Some products contain NAD+ precursors such as NR or NMN. Other wellness programs offer NAD+ itself through routes such as intravenous or injectable administration. The route matters. Different compounds and methods of administration can be absorbed, processed and studied differently. ORAL PRECURSORS Compounds such as NR and NMN participate in biological pathways involved in NAD+ metabolism. DIRECT NAD+ THERAPY NAD+ itself may be administered directly in certain provider-guided wellness programs. IMPORTANT DISTINCTION Research involving oral NAD+ precursors should not automatically be used to predict the effects of direct NAD+ therapy. THE WELLPEPS APPROACH When prescribed, WellPeps provides access to direct NAD+ therapy through a licensed healthcare provider rather than presenting oral precursor research as proof of a particular treatment outcome. SMART PATIENT QUESTION Am I receiving NAD+ itself or an NAD+ precursor—and what evidence applies to that specific approach? 07

SMART PATIENT GUIDE TO NAD+ THERAPY PERSONALIZED TREATMENT Could NAD+ Therapy Be Appropriate for You? There isn’t one profile of the “typical” NAD+ patient. People exploring NAD+ may have different wellness interests, health histories, medications and expectations. That is why the question shouldn’t simply be: “Do I want NAD+?” A better question is: “Is NAD+ therapy appropriate for me?” A licensed healthcare provider can consider factors including: YOUR HEALTH HISTORY Your overall medical background and relevant health circumstances. CURRENT MEDICATIONS & SUPPLEMENTS What you’re already taking and whether there are relevant considerations. YOUR WELLNESS GOALS What led you to explore NAD+ in the first place. THE SPECIFIC TREATMENT The formulation, route, instructions and other treatment-specific considerations. THE WELLPEPS APPROACH WellPeps begins with a health assessment and licensed-provider review so treatment can be considered in the context of the individual patient. SMART PATIENT QUESTION Why is this particular therapy being considered for me? 08

SMART PATIENT GUIDE TO NAD+ THERAPY KNOW WHAT TO WATCH FOR What About Side Effects? “Naturally occurring in the body” does not mean a therapy is automatically risk-free. Receiving NAD+ as a treatment is different from the NAD+ your body naturally produces and regulates. Potential effects can depend on factors such as the formulation, dose, route of administration and individual response. SMART PATIENT GUIDE TO NAD+ THERAPY SET REALISTIC EXPECTATIONS What Should You Expect From NAD+ Therapy? One of the most reasonable questions about NAD+ is also one of the hardest to answer: What will I actually notice? At this point, there isn’t one established wellness response that every patient should expect from direct NAD+ therapy. Research continues to examine NAD+ biology and NAD+-related interventions, but results from one compound, route or population should not automatically be generalized to another. That means NAD+ therapy is better approached with specific goals and realistic expectations than with promises. Before treatment, consider: THE WELLPEPS APPROACH WellPeps provides provider-guided access and ongoing support without promising a specific treatment outcome. Why am I interested in NAD+? What does my provider think is realistic? What evidence applies to the therapy I’m receiving? How will I evaluate my experience? SMART PATIENT INSIGHT A responsible wellness program should help you understand uncertainty—not replace it with promises. 10

SMART PATIENT GUIDE TO NAD+ THERAPY FOLLOW THE SCIENCE What Does the Research Tell Us? NAD+ research includes basic cellular science, animal research and a growing body of human studies. Understanding which type of evidence you’re looking at matters. WHAT IS WELL ESTABLISHED NAD+ is essential to cellular energy metabolism and participates in numerous other normal cellular processes. WHAT HUMAN STUDIES HAVE SHOWN Human studies involving NAD+ precursors such as NR and NMN demonstrate that NAD+-related biomarkers can be influenced. Studies examining clinical outcomes have produced mixed results depending on the intervention, population and outcome studied. WHAT IS LESS ESTABLISHED Direct parenteral NAD+ therapy has considerably less controlled human outcomes research for wellness applications than oral NAD+ precursors. WHAT WE ARE STILL LEARNING Who may benefit from particular NAD+- related approaches Which forms, doses and routes are most useful Whether changes in NAD+ biology translate into meaningful clinical or wellness outcomes What longer-term treatment may mean for different patient populations SMART PATIENT INSIGHT Good science isn’t weakened by acknowledging what we don’t know. That’s how better answers are eventually found. 11

SMART PATIENT GUIDE TO NAD+ THERAPY USE THE CHECKLIST The Smart Patient’s NAD+ Checklist You don’t need to become an expert in NAD+ metabolism. You need enough information to ask good questions. 01 Understand your goal Why are you considering NAD+ therapy, and what are you hoping to address? 02 Know what you’re receiving Are you receiving NAD+ itself, NR, NMN or another NAD+-related product? 03 Match the evidence to the treatment Does the research being discussed involve the same compound and route you’re considering? 04 Understand the medication Is the treatment FDA-approved or compounded? 05 Know the risks What side effects, interactions or other treatment considerations should you understand? 06 Set realistic expectations What does current evidence suggest—and what remains uncertain? 07 Ask what happens next Who will answer questions or help if your treatment needs change? Be interested in the science. Be skeptical of promises. Ask enough questions to understand what you’re receiving and why. 13

IMPORTANT INFORMATION Educational information, not medical advice. This guide is provided for general educational purposes only and is not a substitute for professional medical advice, diagnosis or treatment. Individual health needs and treatment considerations vary. Prescription and provider-directed therapies may have risks, side effects, contraindications and interactions and may not be appropriate for everyone. Prescription treatment requires evaluation by a licensed healthcare provider and is not guaranteed. Individual experiences vary, and no specific treatment outcome is guaranteed. NAD+ has established roles in normal human biology, but research into direct NAD+ administration for wellness applications remains evolving. Findings involving NAD+ precursors such as NR or NMN should not automatically be interpreted as evidence of outcomes from direct NAD+ therapy. NAD+ therapy offered through a wellness program may involve compounded medication. Compounded medications are not FDA-approved finished drug products. FDA does not review compounded medications for safety, effectiveness or quality before marketing in the same manner as FDA-approved drugs. A licensed healthcare provider determines whether treatment and a particular formulation may be appropriate based on individual medical circumstances. NAD+ therapy should not be expected to reverse aging, extend lifespan or guarantee improvements in energy, cognition, recovery or general well- being.
